prd.title: Login Page
prd.overview: The Login Page is the persona-picker login surface for Phase 1. Five personas (Pia, Priya, Anjali, Karim, Vendor). Click persona → POST /api/auth/login → session IDB write → surakkha:session-changed event → redirect to landingFor(session.role). Mock auth via MSW (real auth deferred to Phase 1.7+). Tier 3 (light) — narrow reconciliation.

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx (220 LOC); persona picker; MSW-backed login

requirement.title: Mount route at / and /login
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx at both / and /login. Wrapped in RequireSession (redirects to landing if session exists).

requirement.title: Persona picker (5 personas)
requirement.description: Render list of 5 personas: Pia (PHA), Priya (utility_operator), Anjali (citizen), Karim (field_technician), Vendor (vendor). Each card: name + role + short bio + role-appropriate icon.

acceptance.criterion: Each card shows name + role + bio

requirement.title: Persona click → login → redirect
requirement.description: Click persona card → POST /api/auth/login { persona_id } → session IDB write → dispatch surakkha:session-changed event → redirect to landingFor(session.role).

requirement.title: Session persists across reloads
requirement.description: Session stored in IDB. On page reload, RequireSession reads IDB and redirects if session valid. Logout clears IDB and redirects back to /login.

acceptance.criterion: Logout clears IDB and returns to /login

requirement.title: Bangla-first toggle on this page
requirement.description: Locale toggle on this page. Bangla-first default per lockdown §11.2. Toggle persists in IDB.

requirement.title: Mock auth via MSW (no real auth in Phase 1)
requirement.description: POST /api/auth/login is MSW-backed. Real auth flow deferred to Phase 1.7+ when backend lands.

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: login-page, …-persona-list, …-persona-card-{pia,priya,anjali,karim,vendor}, …-persona-card-name, …-persona-card-role, …-persona-card-bio.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN; persona display names)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for persona display names, role labels, bios, login button. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm 5 personas + redirect
requirement.description: Verify all 5 personas render; verify login flow redirects to landingFor(role) for each role; verify session persists; verify no Hindi strings.

acceptance.criterion: Redirect test passes for each role

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Mount /login; assert 5 persona cards render. All personas present.
Click Priya card; intercept POST /api/auth/login; assert redirect to /dashboard. Login flow works.
Login as Anjali; reload; assert still logged in. Logout; assert redirect to /login. Session persists + logout works.
